# Security Policy

Sokki runs entirely on-device: audio and transcripts never leave the Mac, and
the app uses Apple frameworks only, with no third-party dependencies.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report it privately through
[a security advisory](https://github.com/Okabe-Junya/sokki/security/advisories/new).
Expect an acknowledgement within 3 days and an assessment within 7 days.
